blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A male passenger suspected of being a trafficking victim was intercepted at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) Terminal 3 for attempting to leave the country using a fake departure stamp, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said Thursday. According to the BI, the 28-year-old passenger was intercepted on Oct. 7 after primary inspection officers flagged a suspicious departure stamp on his passport.
